places-cueva-de-los-cascarones-friso-de-.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-cueva-de-los-cascarones-friso-de-.story: A 73 km round trip from Socovos - roughly 1 h 16 in the saddle. It goes by way of Fuensanta II, friso de los Gitanos o Abrigo del Cazador and back through Fuensanta II. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

legend-teide-national-park-road.slogan: Teide National Park Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-teide-national-park-road.story: curated scenic road. volcano, caldera, high altitude. 33 km from La Orotava to Vilaflor, about 36 min of riding. The stops in between: Realejo Alto, La Guancha and Guía de Isora. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Teide National Park Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 10 km this is Teide National Park Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
